hints.auto_price_review: Automatically flag items for price review when cost changes
hints.margin_alert_threshold: Alert when margin falls below this percentage
hints.price_publish_strategy: How price changes are published to sales channels
hints.approval_threshold: Price changes above this % require approval before publishing
hints.channel_publish_delay: Minutes to wait before publishing price changes
hints.allow_negative_margin: Allow products to be sold below cost
hints.default_sort_strategy: Default item sorting for preparation and picking
hints.max_orders_per_wave: Maximum orders included in a single wave
hints.require_batch_approval: Require manager approval before executing each batch
hints.reservation_mode: When inventory is reserved for confirmed orders
hints.shortage_action: Action to take when reserved stock is unavailable
hints.auto_reorder: Automatically create purchase orders at reorder point
hints.reorder_threshold_days: Days of stock remaining to trigger reorder
hints.allow_bom_substitution: Allow alternate BOM components when primary is unavailable
hints.scrap_tolerance_pct: Maximum acceptable scrap percentage per production run
hints.require_qc_sign_off: Require QC approval before marking production complete
hints.allow_order_edit_after_confirm: Allow editing confirmed orders within the time window
hints.edit_window_minutes: Minutes after confirmation that edits are allowed
hints.require_reason_on_cancel: Require a reason note when cancelling orders
hints.auto_cancel_unpaid_hours: Automatically cancel unpaid orders after this many hours
hints.cod_verification_required: Require photo/signature proof for COD collections
hints.allow_partial_delivery: Allow delivering a subset of ordered items
hints.carrier_selection_mode: How delivery carrier is assigned to shipments
hints.driver_reassignment_mode: How drivers are reassigned when unavailable
hints.proof_of_delivery_required: Require delivery proof before marking delivered
hints.enable_loyalty_points: Award loyalty points on completed orders
hints.points_per_egp: Loyalty points awarded per unit spent
hints.tier_upgrade_mode: How customer tiers are evaluated and upgraded
hints.campaign_daily_budget_cap: Maximum daily spend across all campaigns
hints.auto_pause_on_budget: Automatically pause campaigns when budget is exhausted
hints.ai_suggestion_confidence: Minimum confidence score for AI suggestions (0–100)
hints.require_approval_for: Which document types require explicit approval
hints.escalation_timeout_hours: Hours before pending approval is escalated
hints.auto_approve_below: Automatically approve amounts below this value
hints.sync_frequency_minutes: How often to sync with connected systems
hints.conflict_resolution: Strategy when sync conflicts are detected
hints.session_timeout_minutes: Minutes of inactivity before session expires
hints.require_mfa: Enforce multi-factor authentication for all users
hints.audit_retention_days: Days to retain audit log entries
hints.order_number_prefix: Text prefix for order number sequences
hints.invoice_number_prefix: Text prefix for invoice number sequences
hints.delegation_allowed: Allow approvers to delegate approval authority
hints.auto_approve_timeout: Automatically approve if not actioned within timeout
hints.merge_orders: Group multiple orders into a single preparation unit.
hints.split_orders: Allow splitting large orders across multiple waves.
hints.partial_preparation: Allow waves to be completed with partial inventory.
hints.publishing_strategy: Controls when approved prices are pushed to the product catalog, WooCommerce, and POS.
hints.discount_value: Maximum allowed discount per order. 0 = no limit.
hints.required_approval_above: Require manager approval when price change exceeds this value.
hints._approval_role: The role required to approve price changes. Coming in a future update.
hints.pending_review_threshold: Show dashboard alert when pending reviews exceed this count.
hints.price_expiration_days: Auto-expire prices after this many days. Leave blank for no expiry.
hints.discount_type: How the maximum discount limit is expressed.
hints.allow_negative_stock: Allow stock levels to go below zero.
hints.cycle_count_frequency_days: How often to trigger inventory cycle count reminders.
hints.stock_alert_threshold_pct: Alert when stock falls below this percentage of reorder point.
hints.recipe_approval_required: Recipes must be approved before production use.
hints.auto_manufacturing: Automatically create production orders to meet demand.
hints.bom_validation: Validate BOM components are available before production.
hints.waste_rules_enabled: Track and account for production waste in cost calculations.
hints.cost_refresh_on_production: Update finished product cost immediately after each production run.
hints.source_entry_policies: Entry status per order source. Options are loaded from the Order Status registry.
hints.payment_proof_policy: When a payment receipt or screenshot is required per payment method.
hints.auto_reserve_inventory: Automatically reserve stock after a new order is created.
hints.customer_matching_policy: Controls how an order handles a phone number that already belongs to an existing customer.
hints.customer_lookup_enabled: Enable phone-based customer lookup when creating orders.
hints.partial_delivery: Allow delivering part of an order when full delivery is not possible.
hints.vip_order_threshold: Orders above this value are flagged as VIP.
hints.confidence_threshold: Min confidence score (0-1) for AI recommendations.
hints.auto_decision_enabled: Allow AI to make decisions automatically above the confidence threshold.
hints.alert_threshold: Show alerts when AI confidence drops below this value.
hints.escalation_after_minutes: Escalate unresolved alerts after this many minutes.
hints.password_expiry_days: Leave blank to disable password expiry.
hints.purchase_approval_threshold: Require approval for purchases above this amount.
